goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account and then navigate the calendar view to the previous month.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field.
Click the blue 'Sign up' button to complete the registration.
Once the dashboard loads and displays the calendar for 'June 2026', click the 'Previous month' button (the left-pointing arrow) located next to the month title.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the sign-up page to the main dashboard interface.
The calendar view initially displays 'June 2026' upon successful login.
After clicking the navigation button, the calendar header updates to display 'May 2026'.
The calendar grid correctly reflects the dates for May 2026.
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or navigation process.
